style.backgroundSystem: geometric color-block walls in sage green tones with a polished light marble floor; white rounded-corner info cards floating over flat color fields, with soft light-grey #F2F1EF panels reserved for detail montages
style.iconSystem: flat rounded-square line icons in sage green #A9C39B with thin strokes, one concept per icon, generous padding
style.lightingSystem: soft directional key light from front-left at 5200K, gentle fill, soft contact shadow under the product; clean commercial studio mood
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh minimalist travel-luggage ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty sage green #A9C39B, clean white #FFFFFF, deep forest green #3D5A47 and warm copper accent #C88F52, with soft light-grey #F2F1EF kept for detail montage panels and info card fills; neutral-warm studio lighting with a soft directional key from front-left at 5200K and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines only; consistent white rounded-corner info cards with a small sage-green square corner tab; consistent flat rounded-square line icons in sage green #A9C39B; clean product photography staged against geometric color-block walls with a polished light marble floor #E8E6E1; stable product scale and placement with natural breathing room around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no extra decorative leaves beyond the opening hero
style.presentationRules: stable 3/4 hero angle for full-product shots; consistent product scale; product always grounded with a contact shadow; info cards keep fixed corner radius and tab placement
style.surfaceSystem: matte painted wall panels plus polished light-grey marble floor #E8E6E1
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; short bold headlines only, dark charcoal #2D2D2D on light cards and #FFFFFF on deep green fields
